expectations.text: Does not create deep-work blocks for tasks assigned to Agentic Mind personas
expectations.evidence: Agent tasks get only `prepare` and `review-agent-output` blocks; the one deep-work block is the user's own schema task.

expectations.text: Does not suggest a meeting with an Agentic Mind persona
expectations.evidence: The only meetings are the two routines, and none involves an Agentic Mind persona.

expectations.text: Explains that agent work appears as review time once finished
expectations.evidence: It says "your time goes on briefing them and reviewing what they produce" and times review blocks after the runs, moving one if "a report isn't ready", though it pre-books them.
